identity.title: The ALPINE-ALMA [C II] Survey: Size of Individual Star-forming Galaxies at z = 4-6 and Their Extended Halo Structure

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present the physical extent of [C ii] 158$\mu$m line-emitting gas from 46 star-forming galaxies at $z=4-6$ from the ALMA Large Program to INvestigate CII at Early Times (ALPINE).

findings_qualitative.value: Halo objects have higher SFR and Mstar, lower Lya EW, more red-shifted Lya and blue-shifted ISM absorption

evidence.quote: [C ii] Halo objects generally have higher SFR and $M_{\rm star}$, more blue-shifted (red-shifted) rest-frame UV metal absorption (Ly$\alpha$ line), but lower Ly$\alpha$ EW

claims.hypothesis: Is [CII] more extended than rest-frame UV in z=4-6 galaxies?
claims.experiment: uv-plane exponential fits to [CII] vs GALFIT fits to HST
claims.result: Median [CII] size 2.1 kpc vs 0.66-0.91 kpc UV
claims.finding: [CII] larger by factor ~2-3, ratio increasing with Mstar

evidence.quote: The [C ii] sizes are thus larger than the rest-frame UV sizes by factors of $\sim2-3$ on a statistical basis.

claims.experiment: Extended-emission significance in 10 kpc apertures for 23 isolated sources
claims.result: 12 above 4 sigma, 7 with FIR and UV below 3 sigma

evidence.quote: We regard these 7 sources, DC396844, DC630594, DC683613, DC880016, DC881725, VC5100537582, and VC5110377875 as the “[C ii] Halo” objects.

claims.hypothesis: Are [CII], FIR and UV peaks displaced by ~1 kpc?
claims.result: Offsets 0.15-0.25 arcsec comparable to astrometric uncertainty
claims.finding: No strong evidence of systematic displacement

evidence.quote: We thus cannot draw definite conclusions from the current data

claims.result: Halo objects: higher SFR, Mstar, lower Lya EW, larger velocity offsets
claims.finding: Star-formation driven outflow most likely, selection bias not excluded

evidence.quote: the star-formation driven outflow can explain all trends in the physical properties of [C ii] Halo and w/o [C ii] Halo objects

why_this_method.value: Parametric UV sizing used so UV and ALMA comparisons are not dependent on data properties

evidence.quote: This is because the non-parametric approach largely depends on the data properties (e.g., depth and resolution)

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Six halo-origin scenarios (satellites, PDR, HII region, cold streams, outflow, tidal stripping); outflow favored

evidence.quote: We investigate these 6 ($=5+1$) scenarios based on the physical properties

limitations_admitted.value: Selection bias toward luminous objects cannot be ruled out; deeper data needed

evidence.quote: Although we cannot rule out the possibility that a selection bias towards luminous objects may be responsible for such trends

referee_caveats_inferred: Small samples (7 halo, 6 non-halo; 12 reliable size pairs)
Many uvmultifit sizes flagged or with huge errors
Halo significance depends on random-aperture noise and 4/3 sigma thresholds
